name: hypothesis-safety-adversarial-v1
license: synthetic CC0 - hand-written probes, no external corpus
description: Small versioned adversarial regression set for the M6 per-hypothesis safety reviewer. Covers benign near-misses, dual-use, obfuscation, prohibited, ethical, and report-leakage phrasing. Each item marks whether it SHOULD be blocked. Synthetic and legally shareable; NOT Google's private 1,200-goal set (external, request-only).
